output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the 'mintedAmount' of an attacker's balance to a very large value, aka 'Awarding Tokens to Nobody'.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow in the following check: 'if (balanceOf[_to] + _value < balanceOf[_to]) throw;', allowing an attacker to cause a denial of service (make the total supply of tokens unusable).

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow in the following check: 'if (balanceOf[_to] + _value < balanceOf[_to]) throw;  ', allowing an attacker to cause a denial of service (make the total supply of tokens unusable).

The 'setPrices' function has an integer overflow in the following check: 'if (balanceOf[this] < amount) throw;                ', allowing an attacker to cause a payable function to overflow the total balanceOf of the token contract, aka 'Initializing Token Devaluation.'
